Musutafu City Life.text: Musutafu is a mid-sized Shizuoka city on Suruga Bay with U.A. Academy on the foothills above it, and the academy colors its daily life. The city's center is Musutafu Station District, a Tokaido shinkansen stop 45 minutes from Tokyo: commuters pack the concourse from seven to nine and five to eight, local students crowd the convenience stores at the north exit after classes, and the Hero Merch Arcade off the south exit sells All Might figures, trading cards and replica costumes to children and collectors. Families shop at Kiyashi Shopping Mall on the south side, where stores stock clothes and seating for every body type, and walk the seawall at Dagobah Municipal Beach Park on weekends. The residential blocks southeast of the station are quiet streets of apartments and family houses around ordinary schools, Aldera High School among them. Small agencies on Hero Agency Row and the city police at Musutafu Police Headquarters handle the everyday calls: bag snatchers, traffic accidents, Quirk scuffles, lost children. Residents grew up watching the U.A. Sports Festival on television, and U.A. students in uniform drawing stares in town on weekends is a familiar sight. Reporters drift up the hill road whenever U.A. is in the news, and locals give them directions with a shrug.
